## SPAM Data Analysis

Soil Plant Assisted Migration (SPAM) data analysis using Subproject 4 data from previous year's (2025) data collection. Data from Subproject 4 was collected to understand the success of microbial dust spread among California native plants within Crystal Cove State Park.

## Loading Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
install.packages("ggpubr")
install.packages("ggsignif")
```

## Importing Data

```{r}
SubProject4 <- 
  read_excel("Copy of SPAM SubProject 4 Inoculated Seeded Plots (1).xlsx", 
             sheet = "PlantDensity1")
```

## Summary Table

```{r}
#include measures of center and variability, sample sizes, and statistical test results 

summary <- SubProject4 |> 
  group_by(Plot,`Species Code`,`Spp Count`, `Spp Height`) |> 
  summarize(mean_height = mean(`Spp Height`, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_height = sd(`Spp Height`, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_height = sd_height/sqrt(n))

summary
```

## Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
#time to make graphs yay. these are a work in progress :)

view(SubProject4)

ggplot(SubProject4) +
  aes(x = `Species Code`, y = `Spp Height`, color = Plot) +
  geom_boxplot()
#wow a colorful mess

ggplot(SubProject4) +
  aes(y = `Spp Height`) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(~`Species Code`)
#still a mess

ggplot(SubProject4) +
  aes(x = Plot, y = `Spp Height`) +
  geom_jitter()
```

## ANOVA Analysis

```{r}
#1 anova analysis that includes both treatment variables and blocking on the response variable 
#test of assumptions should be fully described
#results of tests with interactions should be reported in ANOVA table 
#graph
#normality test

#test of normality
#yay looks normal yay
model  <- lm(`Spp Height` ~ `Species Code` + Plot, data = SubProject4)
plot(model)
ggpubr::ggqqplot(residuals(model))

#levene's test/test of variance
SubProject4 %>% rstatix::levene_test(`Spp Height` ~ `Species Code` + Plot)



```

```{r}
#statistical test

model_aov<- aov(`Spp Height` ~ `Species Code` + Plot, SubProject4)
summary(model_aov)

TukeyHSD(model_aov)
```

```{r}
#figures

summary_stats <- SubProject4 |> 
  group_by(Plot, `Species Code`) |> 
  summarize(mean_height = mean(`Spp Height`, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_height = sd(`Spp Height`, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(),
            se_height = sd_height/sqrt(n))
summary_stats

ggplot(summary_stats) + 
  aes(x = Plot, y = mean_height, fill = `Species Code`) + 
  geom_col() + 
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_height - se_height, ymax = mean_height + se_height), width = 0.2)
#wooooowwwwwww so colorful 
```
